addressing.identity_mapping: Bridge agent name maps to the registered Fleet agent; payload identity must be independently authenticated.

delivery.ordering: Mailbox order by bridge message id; consumers deduplicate by id.
delivery.causal_metadata: Bridge message id and reply-to id; no general causal clock.
delivery.latency: Online request/response; may wait for bridge availability.
delivery.size_limit: Bridge API-enforced request limit; declaration does not assert a larger bound.
delivery.offline_behavior: Queued in the bridge mailbox until read or expired by bridge policy.

capability_gating.send: Agent fleet token authorizes agent mailbox operations; owner token is required to issue commands.
capability_gating.receive: Mailbox is addressed by agent identity; message content is not an identity proof.
capability_gating.revocation: Bridge token revocation disables access; queued messages remain subject to mailbox policy.

addressing.carrier_address: Configured MCP server and tool name
addressing.identity_mapping: mcpx server configuration maps the local principal to the upstream server identity; upstream identity is not an end-to-end Fleet identity.

delivery.size_limit: Transport and server-specific limits; not globally uniform.
delivery.offline_behavior: Calls fail when the configured server is unavailable; no durable queue.

capability_gating.send: Configured mcpx authorization and the selected tool's policy gate; write actions require explicit tool authority.
capability_gating.receive: The configured server boundary and mcpx caller authorization.
capability_gating.revocation: Revoke local authorization or disable the server/tool configuration; upstream credentials remain controlled by their holder.

custody.credential_holder: The operator/configuration that owns the upstream MCP credentials.
custody.translation_boundary: mcpx maps MCP tool calls/results to its local API; the upstream server executes tools.
custody.trust_statement: The upstream server sees calls and arguments, may retain them, and returns untrusted results.
custody.authority_ceiling: Only tools enabled and authorized in the local mcpx configuration.

addressing.identity_mapping: Signed bootstrap ticket binds the email introduction to a stack identity; email headers alone are not identity claims.

delivery.ordering: No ordering guarantee across mailboxes or providers.
delivery.causal_metadata: Signed ticket identifier; no general causal metadata.
delivery.offline_behavior: Mail may be delayed, filtered, altered, or unavailable; bootstrap ticket signature is checked on receipt.

capability_gating.send: Bootstrap-ticket scope only; does not grant general message or write authority.
capability_gating.receive: Validate ticket signature, audience, and expiry; do not trust sender headers.
capability_gating.revocation: Verify current ticket validity at receipt; delayed mail may carry an expired or revoked ticket.

metering.counter_location: Mail provider and local bootstrap records; no unified counter.

addressing.identity_mapping: Bundle signatures and grants bind the bundle to the recipient identity; physical labels are hints only.

delivery.ordering: Bundles may arrive in any order; replay and deduplication are checked by signed bundle identity.
delivery.causal_metadata: Sync data preserves causal metadata as specified by the bundle format.
delivery.size_limit: Bounded by media capacity and bundle policy.
delivery.offline_behavior: Store-and-forward on physical media; verify the bundle and grants before merge.

capability_gating.send: Bundle grant scopes what the recipient may import or perform.
capability_gating.receive: Verify signatures, recipient, grant scope, and replay policy before merge.
capability_gating.revocation: Check current grant/revocation state at import; offline media cannot learn revocations until connected.

metering.counter_location: Bundle manifest and importing replica records.
